query:
SELECT m.id, m.chatId, m.direction, m.senderType, m.content, m.messageType, m.avitoTimestamp, c.customerName 
FROM messages m 
JOIN chats c ON m.chatId = c.id 
WHERE c.customerName LIKE '%ирина%' OR c.customerName LIKE '%Ирина%'
ORDER BY m.avitoTimestamp DESC 
LIMIT 15
